title: loader.py does not support ignore_mismatched_sizes → breaks loading valid checkpoints (GLM-OCR / GQA models)
bodyExcerpt:
### Reminder

- [x] I have read the above rules and searched the existing issues.

### System Info

## Description

When loading certain models (e.g. GLM-OCR / GLM4V variants with GQA),
`from_pretrained` fails due to shape mismatches even though the checkpoint is valid.

Root cause:
- `ignore_mismatched_sizes=True` is not passed in LLaMA-Factory's loader
- transformers>=5.0 defaults to strict shape checking

## Error

RuntimeError: size mismatch for ...
(occurs during AutoModel.from_pretrained)

## Minimal Fix

In `llamafactory/model/loader.py`, before calling:

    model = load_class.from_pretrained(**init_kwargs)

add:

    init_kwargs.setdefault("ignore_mismatched_sizes", True)

## Why this matters

- Many modern models (GQA, MoE, multimodal variants) legitimately differ in shapes
- Transformers already supports safe loading via ignore_mismatched_sizes
- Current behavior prevents using valid checkpoints

## Additional Note

Attempting to patch this externally (e.g. via string replacement)
can easily break indentation and introduce syntax errors,
so this should be handled inside the library.

## Environment

- transformers: 5.0.0
- trl: 1.2.0
- torch: 2.10
- LLaMA-Factory: latest
